Provide the remaining reusable Curator maintenance capability through shared sources and a neutral Template.

User value: Keep project information, documentation, selected dependencies and maintenance state current without unnecessary work.

### Success outcomes

- Retain the40 active tasks and37 active requirements identified in this revision.
- Preserve unrelated application behavior, project data and existing source history.
- Keep removed category records outside active execution and acceptance.

## Scope

### In scope

- Shared-source maintenance, compatible Task intake and role descriptions.
- Durable local events, snapshots, ordinary coordination and recovery.
- Knowledge, descriptive documentation, learning and dependency compatibility work.
- Inactive scheduling, notices, conversational selection and original-work continuity.
- Neutral Template distribution, versioned setup and separately selected adoption.
- Verification and metrics for the remaining application scope.

### Out of scope

### Execution authority

### Constraints

- Current invocation writes only managed plan state/projections/index. Plan approval and implementation authorization remain separate; all 50 tasks start planned with no implementation evidence.
- Implement reusable assets in their source collections and change distribution tooling only for its declared responsibility; do not refresh active-root installed governance, skills or Roles.
- Execution uses a real confirmed Task manager, fresh role catalog and matching model/reasoning settings; this plan does not pre-activate or reserve any manager or shrink required category teams.
- Shared sources must remain standard-library compatible except independently selected existing backend manifests. No new production dependency is proposed for the core.
- Current source versions and ownership must be rechecked at execution; concurrent changes or incompatible editions require exact revalidation rather than overwriting work.
- Mapped Template files are generated outputs; coordinate source publication with the existing watcher and check/apply/check, preserving all unrelated contents.
- No parallel group is predeclared: current plan artifacts share owner packages, so the execution manager may delegate non-overlapping bounded work only after fresh fit/scope checks.
- Current required root Task/plan workflows may record this implementation once separately activated; such ledger writes are distinct from adopting Curator into the active root.
- This revision changes plan metadata only; implementation remains paused.
- The listed historical IDs are excluded from active work and acceptance.

| `DEC-001` | `approved` | Shared sources first. U02 narrows R01's broader rollout.
